label: TP-Link TL-SG2210MP
description: TP-Link Omada TL-SG2210MP - 8x 1G PoE+ (802.3af/at, 150 W budget) plus 2x 1G SFP; web-managed smart switch, fanless.

poe.note: Vendor spec rows: "PoE+ Ports: 8 Ports", "PoE Power Budget: 150 W", "up to 30 W on each port" (802.3af/at). The budget is the supply, not 8 x 30 W; it limits a full row of PoE+ loads, which is why the ports declare 30 W and the chassis declares 150 W.
